objective_value: <float> Total number of bin-period pairs used across the entire planning horizon.

assignments.item_id: <int> Identifier of the treatment item being assigned.
assignments.bin: <int> Bin to which this item is assigned.
assignments.period: <int> Time period in which this item is scheduled.
assignments.weight: <int> Weight of this item consuming capacity in the assigned bin-period.

active_bin_periods.bin: <int> Bin identifier for this used bin-period pair.
active_bin_periods.period: <int> Time period for this used bin-period pair.
active_bin_periods.items: <list[int]> Identifiers of all items assigned to this bin in this period.
active_bin_periods.total_weight: <int> Combined weight of all items assigned to this bin in this period.

num_active_bin_periods: <int> Total count of bin-period pairs that contain at least one item.
